hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom-curve AMM hook that routes swaps through Euler Finance lending vaults, bypassing Uniswap v4 concentrated liquidity entirely. In beforeSwap, it computes quotes via a proprietary reserve-curve invariant, deposits input tokens into an Euler vault, withdraws output tokens from another Euler vault, and returns a full BeforeSwapDelta to settle all accounting with the pool manager.
